description: Source code implementing SATA and DMA control functions for Oxford Semiconductor hardware, including register access, SATA initialization, and workarounds for hardware bugs.

methods.name: ide_preinit
methods.description: Initializes SATA disks, resets hardware blocks, applies workarounds, and detects connected SATA devices.

methods.name: ide_inb
methods.description: Reads a byte from SATA register ports for a specified device.

methods.name: ide_outb
methods.description: Writes a byte to SATA register ports for a specified device, handling command sequences.

methods.name: ide_input_data
methods.description: Receives data from SATA device into buffer using DMA, with hardware bug workaround.

methods.name: ide_output_data
methods.description: Sends data to SATA device from buffer using DMA.

methods.name: scr_read
methods.description: Reads a register via SATA link registers with timeout.

methods.name: scr_write
methods.description: Writes a register via SATA link registers with timeout.

methods.name: workaround5458
methods.description: Applies hardware-specific register adjustments for PHY workarounds.
